source: Imperium Nihilus: Vigilus Ablaze (Source.csv 000000060, 8th edition, errata 13.07.2020). Codex: Chaos Space Marines (Source.csv 000000012, 9th edition, errata 05.01.2023) has its own Vicious Descent (000002235026).

name: Bringers of Despair
source: Imperium Nihilus: Vigilus Ablaze (Source.csv 000000060, 8th edition, errata 13.07.2020), the Bringers of Despair Specialist Detachment stratagem. Codex: Chaos Space Marines (Source.csv 000000012, 9th edition, errata 05.01.2023) reuses the name for a Black Legion stratagem (000003298002); identically named stratagems count as the same stratagem (01_Core_Rules/Core_Stratagems.md §1).
